## Summary

## Linked issue

<!-- e.g. Closes #123, Refs #456 -->

## Type of change

<!--
Tick one. The PR title must be a Conventional Commit, scoped by issue number:
  type(#issue): description     e.g. feat(#56): add faststream integration
Squash merge uses this title as the commit, so it drives the release.
-->

- [ ] `feat:` — new feature
- [ ] `fix:` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs:` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor:` — code change, no behavior change
- [ ] `perf:` — performance improvement
- [ ] `test:` — tests only
- [ ] `build:` — build system or dependencies
- [ ] `ci:` — CI configuration
- [ ] `chore:` — other changes (tooling, housekeeping)
- [ ] `revert:` — reverts a previous commit
- [ ] Contains a **BREAKING CHANGE** (add `!`, e.g. `feat(#56)!: ...`)

## How was this tested?

<!-- Commands run and what they cover. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `uv run ruff format .` applied
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] `uv run ty check src/pyverge` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Documentation updated (if user-facing)
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
